name: feature-dev
description: CopilotHarness feature-dev pipeline: plan → design → code → review with evaluator firewall and 3-attempt correction loop.

skillLocality.rationale: Week 4 Day 2 decision — skills stay at repo-global .github/skills/ for v1. Multiple pipelines will reuse the same skills (python, code-review, testing) so duplicating them per pipeline would fragment the knowledge base. Revisit when (a) a pipeline-specific skill with no reuse appears, or (b) a second repo needs to copy-paste install a pipeline without its skills. If revisited, skill_loader needs a multi-dir fallback mirroring state.AGENTS_DIRS.
